topic_bellman.title: Bellman Expectation & Optimality Equations
topic_bellman.notes: Fundamental recursive decomposition of value functions V(s) and Q(s,a). Contraction mapping theorem under max-norm.

topic_q_sarsa.title: Q-Learning vs SARSA (Off-Policy vs On-Policy TD)
topic_q_sarsa.notes: Target differences: max_a' Q(s',a') vs Q(s', a'). Cliff walking cliff-edge exploration dynamics.

topic_dqn.title: Deep Q-Networks (DQN): Experience Replay & Target Networks
topic_dqn.notes: Deadly triad resolution (function approximation, bootstrapping, off-policy). Loss formulation and gradients.

topic_reinforce.title: Policy Gradient Theorem & REINFORCE with Baseline
topic_reinforce.notes: Derivation using log-derivative trick. Proof that baseline b(s) has expectation zero gradient.

topic_ppo.title: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Clipped Surrogate
topic_ppo.notes: Pessimistic lower bound objective min(r_t(theta) * A_t, clip(...) * A_t). Why clipping prevents policy collapse.

topic_dpo.title: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) Derivation
topic_dpo.notes: Closed-form reward substitution r(x,y) = beta * log(pi(y|x) / pi_ref(y|x)) + beta * log Z(x) into Bradley-Terry loss.

topic_ai_control.title: AI Control Protocols & Untrusted Monitoring
topic_ai_control.notes: Trusted monitoring vs untrusted generation, deferral to humans / trusted models, auditing for sabotage.

topic_transformers.title: Transformer Scaled Dot-Product Attention & Dynamics
topic_transformers.notes: Softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V. Proof of variance of dot product and gradient vanishing in softmax without scaling.

topic_ioi.title: Indirect Object Identification (IOI) Circuit in LLMs
topic_ioi.notes: Name mover heads, S-inhibition heads, Duplicate token heads, Induction heads. Activation patching methodology.

topic_linear_probes.title: Linear Probes & Representation Geometry
topic_linear_probes.notes: Linear representation hypothesis. Probe training, difference in means, causal intervention (activation addition).

paper_vaswani_2017.title: Attention Is All You Need
paper_vaswani_2017.notes: Introduced the Transformer architecture eliminating recurrent and convolutional layers in favor of self-attention.

paper_schulman_2017.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
paper_schulman_2017.notes: Introduced clipped surrogate objective as a scalable, sample-efficient first-order alternative to TRPO.

paper_rafailov_2023.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
paper_rafailov_2023.notes: Directly optimizes preference loss without explicit reward modeling or RL sampling in the loop.

paper_wang_2022.title: Interpretability in the Wild: a Circuit for Indirect Object Identification in GPT-2 Small
paper_wang_2022.notes: End-to-end mechanistic discovery of a 26-head circuit solving the IOI task in GPT-2 Small.

paper_greenblatt_2023.title: AI Control: Improving Safety Despite Intentional Subversion
paper_greenblatt_2023.notes: Framework for safely using potentially sub-optimally aligned or untrusted models to do useful cognitive work.

q_bellman_deriv.prompt: Derive the Bellman Expectation Equation for V_pi(s) and the Bellman Optimality Equation for V*(s) from first principles. Prove why the Bellman Optimality operator is a gamma-contraction in the infinity norm, and state what this implies for Value Iteration.

q_ppo_clip_deriv.prompt: Write the exact mathematical formulation of the PPO Clipped Surrogate Objective L^CLIP(theta). Explain precisely why the min() operator is applied against the unclipped objective, and dissect the 4 cases (positive vs negative advantage with ratio greater/smaller than 1 +/- epsilon).

q_dpo_math_deriv.prompt: Derive the DPO loss function starting from the KL-constrained RL objective max_pi E[r(x,y)] - beta * D_KL(pi || pi_ref). Show step-by-step how the partition function Z(x) cancels out when substituted into the Bradley-Terry preference probability P(y_w > y_l | x).

q_reinforce_baseline.prompt: Derive the Policy Gradient Theorem for episodic MDPs using the log-derivative trick. Prove mathematically that subtracting an arbitrary state-dependent baseline b(s) does not introduce bias into the gradient estimator.

q_dqn_stability.prompt: Explain the deadly triad in Deep RL and how DQN overcomes instability. Write the exact DQN loss function using target network parameters theta^-, and explain mathematically why non-stationary targets cause divergent gradient dynamics without theta^-.

q_transformer_scaling.prompt: Prove that if components of query vector q and key vector k are independent random variables with mean 0 and variance 1, their dot product q^T k has variance d_k. Explain how large variances push the softmax into regions with vanishing gradients, and why dividing by sqrt(d_k) restores unit variance.

q_ioi_mechanisms.prompt: Deconstruct the 3 main classes of attention heads in the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit (Duplicate Token Heads, S-Inhibition Heads, Name Mover Heads). Explain the signal flow across the residual stream, how activation patching was used to isolate each group, and what failure modes occur if S-inhibition is ablated.

q_paper_dpo_review.prompt: Synthesize the core claims, methodology, empirical results, and key theoretical limitations of the DPO paper (Rafailov et al. 2023). Include a crisp ELI5 comparison of DPO vs classic PPO-based RLHF.
